name: Mentor someone
summary: Mentor someone with session agendas and a regular check-in rhythm.

plan_blueprint.calendar: Sessions on the chosen slots with an agenda attached and a short check-in reminder between sessions.

approach_variants.habit: Same slot every time, with a two-minute prep before each session.
approach_variants.willpower: A stretch goal for the mentee each session and a 12-week finish line.
approach_variants.time: Sessions and prep are calendar blocks with the agenda attached.
approach_variants.reward: Celebrate each milestone the mentee reaches together.
approach_variants.resource: First week gathers reading, tools or contacts the mentee will need.

guardrails: Notes about the person you mentor stay private.
Mentoring is guidance between people; it is not counselling or professional advice.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
restart_rules: A missed session is rescheduled within the week if possible.
